description: The Canonical GTFS Schedule Validator, maintained by MobilityData, checks static GTFS feeds against the GTFS Schedule standard. The README describes a cross-platform Java application that loads a feed ZIP from a URL or disk, checks file integrity, numeric parsing and ranges, performs full validation against the standard and produces an HTML report that can be shared. A web-based version runs at gtfs-validator.mobilitydata.org, and releases are published on GitHub. Coverage: any GTFS Schedule feed. Format and access: open-source application and free web service. Licence and cost: Apache 2.0, free. Caveats: it validates static schedules only; the README is for the version under active development. It supports network flow models by catching feed errors before routing or assignment. It relates to the GTFS specification, GTFS Kit, which recommends it, and the GTFS Scorecard service, which uses it, in the catalogue.
